analyses.name: Dataset shift
analyses.question: What does the S2-fresh-384 add relative to S1-128?
methods: Compare S1-128 vs S2-fresh-384 distributions: game length, legal-action counts, chosen action types, policy entropy, visit entropy, value targets, duplicate observation/information-set rates.
Measure whether S2-fresh examples are near-duplicates of the S1/M22 self-play distribution or add new strategic contexts.
Compare S1 vs S2 first-128 nested overlap as a sanity check.

metrics.exact_information_set_overlap: fraction of S2-fresh information sets already present in S1-128; descriptive only, expected approximately 0 because M24-S2 has duplicate_information_set_rate 0.0
metrics.novel_information_set_fraction: 1 - exact_information_set_overlap; descriptive only, does NOT by itself imply strategic novelty
metrics.strata_definition: 3 phases x 7 action types x 4 legal-action bins = 84 canonical strata

analyses.name: Shared-reference model behavior
analyses.question: On the same frozen S1 reference positions, how do S1 and S2 checkpoints differ in policy/value?
methods: Use the frozen S1 reference validation subset (game_index % 4 == 0, 1953 examples).
Compare S1/S2 policy entropy, top-1 agreement, policy CE vs targets, Value MSE/calibration, and phase/action-type sliced metrics.
Produce a shared-reference model behavior matrix.

metrics.policy_ce_improvement_bps: relative improvement from S1 to S2 on fixed reference
metrics.value_mse_improvement_bps: relative improvement from S1 to S2 on fixed reference
metrics.top1_delta: absolute S2 - S1 top-1 on fixed reference

analyses.name: M07 disagreement
analyses.question: Does S2 move closer to or farther from M07 on frozen stratified positions?

position_selection.phase_definition: phase = opening if ply < 20; midgame if 20 <= ply < 40; endgame if ply >= 40
position_selection.action_type_definition: use chosen_action.type from the canonical action categories: take_tokens, buy_market, buy_reserved, reserve_market, reserve_deck, choose_noble, pass

quota_algorithm.stratum_count: number of eligible examples in that stratum within the source
quota_algorithm.source_count: total eligible examples in that source
quota_algorithm.remainder_allocation: descending fractional remainder, then ascending canonical stratum key

trim_loop.choose_stratum: 1. current quota descending; 2. canonical stratum key ascending

deterministic_selector.encoding: UTF-8 concatenation of diagnosis_id and information_set_hash

position_selection.sparse_stratum_rule: Non-empty strata with computed quota 0 receive at least 1; the trim loop resolves any resulting over-allocation deterministically.

output.semantic_hash: sha256 of canonical JSON output, to be recorded after selection

metrics.top1_agreement: fraction of positions where model top-1 action equals M07 top-1 action
metrics.rank_correlation: average rank correlation between model policy ranking and M07 root ranking

methods: Run M07 root analysis on the frozen stratified position set.
Measure S1/S2 policy vs M07 action choice/ranking agreement, rank correlation, top-1 agreement, and disagreement rates.
This is the key next-stage indicator.

ranking_definition.universe: exact legal_actions in canonical action order
ranking_definition.missing_or_invalid_action_rule: if any legal action is missing or invalid on either side, that position is excluded and the diagnostic manifest must record the exclusion
ranking_definition.aggregation: mean rho over all selected positions
ranking_definition.top1_tie_break: first action in canonical legal_actions order

analyses.name: Strength attribution
analyses.question: Which phase/action/confidence/value patterns explain the Arena anchor regression?
methods: Slice Arena results by opening/mid/endgame and action types where possible.
Correlate S2 vs S1 policy confidence and value error with M07 anchor delta.
Run mandatory D2 fixed-model search-budget sensitivity.

stage_0_materialization.description: Before applying D2 mutations, S2-containing templates must first inherit the already accepted M24 S2 materialization. This is not a D2 experimental mutation.

forbidden_mutations: All other fields must remain byte/semantic identical to the accepted source plan: sample_seed, checkpoint identity, M07 search config, heuristic identity, python/module root, catalog, PUCT/depth, timeouts, seat rotations.
d2_search_sensitivity.statistic: pairwise center score bps using the same integer formula as M24 Arena; lower bound via frozen Hoeffding if needed

A_redundancy_evidence.source_metric: 84-stratum distribution similarity between entire S1-128 and S2-fresh-384

B_shared_ref_improvement.source: B metrics on fixed S1 reference subset

C_m07_no_improvement.delta_meaning: S2 value minus S1 value on C selected positions

D2_monotonic.definition: anchor_delta_m07_bps(16) <= anchor_delta_m07_bps(32) <= anchor_delta_m07_bps(64) AND anchor_delta_m07_bps(64) - anchor_delta_m07_bps(16) >= 50

teacher_drift.definition: A_redundancy_evidence AND C_m07_no_improvement AND NOT D2_rescue

representation_capacity_evidence.definition: B_shared_ref_improvement AND NOT A_redundancy_evidence AND C_m07_no_improvement AND NOT D2_rescue

decision_gate.precedence: If more than one branch matches its predicate, the decision is INCONCLUSIVE.

branches.predicate: A_redundancy_evidence AND C_m07_no_improvement AND NOT D2_rescue
branches.action: M25 strong GPU warm-start v2 with M07 teacher corpus

branches.predicate: NOT (teacher OR search OR representation) OR multiple branches true
branches.action: one additional frozen diagnostic, not another 2048-game brute-force run

constraints: All heavy outputs remain under local-artifacts; compact manifests tracked.
